thread:
evan: FYI - canary for MIG-1567 (add payload_index) spiked with index rebuild contention on shard 13 during backfill. Seeing repeated 'waiting for exclusive lock' in lockwatch. Holding tonight's midnight window?
leah: saw the same in staging. the reindex job is doing a concurrent rebuild but our backfill updates keep fighting it.
omar: quick question - did we enable INCREMENTAL_REINDEX? that should avoid long exclusive locks.
evan: no, the migration uses a full CONCURRENT reindex step followed by UPDATEs from backfill workers. we can switch to incremental approach in a pinned build: MIG-1567-inc.
deploybot: MIG-1567 scheduled window 00:00-06:00 UTC. Current status: HOLD due to lockwatch alerts. Auto-pause rule: pause_on_lock_threshold=3/5m. :exclamation:
leah: ops plan suggestion:
1) pause backfill workers on canary hosts (`pkill -USR1 backfill`)
2) deploy pinned version MIG-1567-inc (changes reindex strategy + BACKFILL_BATCH=100)
3) add temporary tourniquet: if lock_count > 2 in 4m, auto-pause and notify #eng-oncall
4) monitor p95/p99 db latency and replica lag for 30m
5) unpin at 05:30 if stable
omar: rollback criteria: if any exclusive lock > 240s OR if deploybot emits two auto-pauses in 15m -> abort rollout and revert pinned_version to previous stable build.
evan: CI artifacts for pinned build: https://ci.internal/mig/1567/inc run_id=run-1567-20260323-01
sre-bot: added alert: page oncall if tourniquet fires. audit note: attach run_id to release notes.
leah: I'm updating infra/deploy/configs/migrations.json to set pinned_version: "MIG-1567-inc" and adding release-note snippet: "use incremental reindex + reduced batch size to avoid exclusive lock contention during backfill"
evan: deploying pinned build to 2 canary shards now, pausing high-concurrency workers.
deploybot: Canary rollout started: shards=2 -> status=IN_PROGRESS. Temporary tourniquet rule applied.
omar: monitoring 10m: still seeing short waits but no exclusive locks >60s. p99 latency flat.
leah: continuing to 20% after 25m. keeping pin until 05:30 as discussed.
sre-bot: please ensure run_id=run-1567-20260323-01 is in the audit entry and attach lockwatch snippets.
evan: attached logs and run_id to release notes. follow-up: create a unit test in backfill-sim that exercises mixed reindex+update patterns.
deploybot: Rollout progressed to 20% -> 60%. No auto-pauses triggered. :white_check_mark:
omar: agreed on postmortem items. closing this thread unless regressions appear.
